items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: I never know if Black Benny's right, full name, but I know he's played trap drums. We call them trap drums. It's orchestra drumming, and he was a bass drum player in the different brass bands around the city.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Hey, would he use that on every tune, like Red Happy would use it?

Yeah, well, I figure some of them on most of every tune. You see, on exception of a slow number, well, a drummer, sometimes he's had it. Slow numbers always was hard on a man playing them. Yeah, yeah. Playing the drums. So when you get it, we used to call them bluesy tempos. Yeah, yeah. The day they called it, they got new names for them. We called them bluesy tempos. Well, I figure he played like I played them them days. Falling by honey, starlight. We played something like this. It's not too much of a flag to…
